description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ImageNotFoundException' used within the 'org.apache.fineract.portfolio.client.exception' package, extending a base exception class. It provides constructors for specific error messaging related to missing images associated with resources identified by resource type and ID.

classes.name: ImageNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that an image resource was not found for a given resource type and ID.

methods.name: ImageNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a resource type and resource ID, generating an appropriate error message.

methods.name: ImageNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a resource type, resource ID, and an underlying cause exception.
